mission.title: Burnt Toast
mission.description: Get some worthwhile data out of Ouroboros' network, then deliver the Merovingian's letter to Ouroboros.

phase.briefing: Our lack of progress in finding the supposed pot of gold in Ouroboros' network is in danger of becoming a serious irritation, operative. We have passwords to their system, so I really don't see what the problem is. Now get in there, and don't come out without some worthwhile data.

enter.say:
Uh-oh, Flood's in one of his regular moods.
Aaaand here's "uh-oh" number two: it looks like there's already an alert at that Ouroboros office. Security personnel are running around in there like it's a two-for-one donut sale.

done.say:
What? Our passwords are the best that kidnapping and torture can buy!
Man, sometimes I just don't know what this world is coming to.

near.say:
Who in the hell could have--
You!
Well, we could have, but we didn't. So who's been mucking around in there?

phase.briefing: That is a very weak excuse, {player}, and if it wasn't for this headache I feel coming on, I'd berate you properly. If you're going to be foiled by a child pulling a fire alarm, then--Oh, never mind. Stop simpering, and make yourself useful.

enter.say: By the way, you can expect a real talking-to once I'm through with this migraine. If I forget, remind me.

done.say: Oh, man, what have they been doing in there? Some joker put a slug through that thing. Great, just great.
I don't know! I think it's a cyber-narc or something.

Oh! I'd better dele-- Uh...
Oops, look at that, I'm late for a meeting. Gotta run!

phase.briefing:
Damn, I thought I had this thing on "vibrate"...
Oh, it's you, operative. What's your excuse this time? Mm-hm... Yes, I know you didn't do it. The pain... Why am I talking...
Go see the Merovingian. Nnn... I'm hanging up now.

enter.say: Did you hear about how we had some people try posing as Agents to get into Ouroboros and "confiscate" data? Yeah, didn't work. Apparently they were given some lip from the Ouroboros guards about "jurisdiction."

objective.text: Get the letter from the Merovingian

talk.say:
Evidently, the Machines, while doing their best to keep us out of Ouroboros, are themselves personae non gratae inside that company's walls. Rather remarkable... And I think Ouroboros would be interested to hear about, oh, the Machines hiring Cypherites to break into their offices, not to mention having some of their own operatives tampering with security systems there.
It is all described in this letter I've prepared. Be so kind as to deliver it to Ouroboros. I think they'll find it...enlightening.

done.say:
See to it that you deliver it to their official personally.
Hmhmhm... The Machines do not have as much practice at playing les deux cotes de la barriere, n'est-ce pas?

phase.briefing:
You're taking the letter to a high-ranking Ouroboros lickspittle that calls itself Erin Allen. Everything's arranged, so you can all but mail this one in, operative.
No, they aren't supposed to know who it's from, you--
Oh gods, my head...

enter.say:
I've got a lot of signals in there, but if Flood's right about this, they should be all peaceful-like.
Hm, wonder how many people have ended up with "If Flood's Right About This" as their epitaph.

objective.text: Give the letter to Erin Allen

done.say:
Hm... Mm...
We'll check into it. Not that we have anything to hide.
Of course. And you're just a concerned voter, right?
This is absurd. I demand to see Ms. Allen immediately.
Agent Lee, if you insist on being disruptive, I'll have to ask you to wait in the hall.

near.say: You'll have to be patient, Agent Lee. She's in a very important meeting.
This is a matter of national security. I am not inclined to wait much longer.

Excuse me, but you'll have to--
Oh. Yes, of course.

mission.finish:
Obviously they know more than they're saying, operative. So do we, and we wouldn't be there if they didn't.
Ohh, I can't explain this to you now. Go ask Malphas.
Why isn't my foot bath ready? ... Don't pretend you didn't hear me!
